Codex rejected: (1) Test uses past deadline (2024-07-01) proving now() > expiresAt, not equality boundary now() >= expiresAt. (2) UI still offers 'Expire' before deadline - users hit guard rejection instead of being directed to 'Revoke'. Fix added guard 'now() >= self.expiresAt' to expire() command in src/workforce/time.manifest, created qualification-expire-deadline.runtime.test.ts, typecheck passes, tests pass. Scope limited to manifest only per backlog item. 1/3 failures - not escalated yet.

Manifest platform limitation: fanOut reactions run AFTER all mutations in a command and don't support != in where clauses. Attempted pattern: emit PaymentMethodDefaultSet  to fanOut PaymentMethod where clientId = X run clearDefault. This clears ALL matching rows including the one being set as default, because: (1) mutate isDefault = true happens first, (2) emit triggers fanOut, (3) fanOut clears ALL rows (no != support), (4) no way to restore the target row after fanOut. Constraints also cannot check across rows (only self.*). This feature requires Manifest platform changes: either != support in fanOut where clauses, cross-row constraints, or a different native exclusivity mechanism. Escalated to backlog.

Codex rejected: (1) Identity mismatch remains - personId == user.id still compares Person FK with auth subject instead of resolving Person.authSubjectId == user.id. (2) Owner-scoped reads removed, not fixed - savedReportRead excludes ordinary owners from their own owner_only reports. (3) Required client-supplied personId breaks existing UI and contradicts never client-supplied ownership rule. (4) Owner command guards fail open - self.owner == null authorizes ordinary staff when owner relation is absent. (5) Generated create events use nonexistent doc.personId. (6) Tests do not prove self-service - event_manager inherits manageAccess. This is a symptom workaround, breaks existing workflow, adds user tedium, and does not satisfy OD052 identity rule. Implementation needs different pattern that properly resolves Person.authSubjectId for identity checks. Worktree preserved at .loop-worktrees/prod-20260721T1852-OD056-saved-report-owner. 1/3 failures.
